_contract: Scene Editor plan §4.3: shell.props.get and shell.panel.changed gain `dialog` (null until a dialog scene is loaded; always null before Stage Q2) and per-panel `declared` (the conf.mix order). Every change of dialog.visible or dialog.scene publishes panel.changed with a strictly greater revision; only an unchanged snapshot publishes nothing. The panel_changed_* examples elide `panels` as {} for brevity; the real notices carry every panel exactly as props_get does.

panel_changed_hide._topic: <host>.panel.changed after × or Escape: same generation, revision advanced

panel_changed_preempted._topic: another owner took the seat: the loader records visible:false and, if shell.scenes.list no longer lists editor, mounted:false

panel_changed_no_dialog._topic: Stage Q1 and later with no dialog loaded; `panels` elided
